job.what: Construct the dvsa-mot-next-test-outcome artifact on a worker (repair relaunch dvsa-mot-build-003; the only construction change vs build-002 is the Deflate64 route: the 2017-2023 DfT zips are compress_type 9 (every member, measured 2026-11-07), stdlib zipfile raised NotImplementedError at 2017 and killed build-002, so open_text_lines now decodes type-9 members through the explicit local-header read + inflate64 route verified in-container on the real 2017 file (1.4 s/member, VmPeak 700 MB, size match), streaming lines through TextIOWrapper - never splitlines on a full member; run.sh installs the pinned inflate64==1.0.4 and verifies the import before any download; the ABRVE value-rule repair from build-002 is unchanged and carries over): download the 20 per-year DVSA/DfT anonymised MOT result files (2005-2016 txt.gz + 2017-2022 zips at data.dft.gov.uk, 2023-2024 zips at the DVSA S3 origin; the 2024 zip byte-pinned to the 2026-10-19 measurement), stream-parse class-4 rows of md5-sampled vehicles (~0.1%), join consecutive completed tests per vehicle, label the next test's initial failure (F/PRS vs P), features strictly from the prior test and earlier, splits by prior-test year (train 2009-2018 / eval 2019-2021 / holdout 2022-2023.11, right-censoring cutoff 2023-11-30), then run the gate 1.5.0 on the FULL artifact on the worker, --accept the exact bytes, and compute the pre-registered reference triad (post-acceptance). No performance metric exists before acceptance; the deciding model-vs-triad check runs in a later baseline job.
job.stopping_condition: a failed build or gate stops the job with the reports preserved for collection; a failed gate is a recorded finding requiring diagnosis before any rebuild; no re-tuning of threshold, window, label or features after any score.
